description: Schedule Lab engine derived from definitive regular-season weekly history. Includes every owner-on-schedule replay, schedule equity, presentation badges, historical findings, and a vetted Random What-If candidate pool.

definitions.expectedWins: Sum of weekly all-play win probabilities based on the owner's own score. Each week compares against the other 9 league scores; ties count as half a win.
definitions.scheduleExpectedWins: Expected wins for a random league team facing the owner's exact opponent scores. Each opponent score is compared against the other 9 league scores; ties count as half a win.
definitions.scheduleDifficultyWins: League-average schedule expected wins minus the owner's schedule expected wins. Positive is tougher; negative is easier.
definitions.scheduleDifficultyIndex: 100 × league-average schedule expected wins ÷ owner's schedule expected wins. Above 100 is tougher than average.
definitions.replayMatrix: Rows are scoring owners; columns are schedule owners. Each cell replays the row owner's weekly scores against the column owner's actual opponent scores.
definitions.scheduleEquity: For each scoring owner, average/best/worst replayed wins across all 10 schedules plus the range between best and worst schedules.
definitions.ties: A tied weekly comparison counts as 0.5 expected wins and is also preserved as a tie in replay records.

scheduleBadgeThresholds.note: Thresholds are presentation labels only. The underlying SOS Index remains continuous.
